description: Restore every heptagon to one color within the visible twist allowance. Drag the disc to steer a face into the fixed central aperture. Turns are immediate and never exceed the visible twist allowance. An incomplete certification or spent twist allowance ends the episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other hidden-state access. Do not switch to unrelated, blank, pre-existing, or browser-settings tabs.
